## ContractFactory

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.InteractiveBrokers.ContractFactory</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/InteractiveBrokers/ContractFactory.cs:24](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/InteractiveBrokers/ContractFactory.cs#L24).

Builds IB contract objects from SymbolConfig. This is split with conditional compilation so the project still builds without IBApi. Define compilation constant IBAPI and reference IBApi to enable the real builder. Fixed income / bond contracts: Set SymbolConfig.InstrumentType to InstrumentType.Bond for corporate bonds (IB SecType = &quot;BOND&quot;). For US Treasuries and other government securities use SecurityType = &quot;GOVT&quot; explicitly — IB routes these to a dedicated government-bond desk and the &quot;BOND&quot; SecType does not apply. For both cases, set SymbolConfig.Symbol to the nine-character CUSIP, e.g. &quot;912828YY0&quot;, and Exchange = &quot;SMART&quot;. The TWS API uses face-value in number of bonds as the order quantity: 1 bond = $1,000 par, so Quantity = 5 submits $5,000 face value.

## EnhancedIBConnectionManager

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Infrastructure.Adapters.InteractiveBrokers.EnhancedIBConnectionManager</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/InteractiveBrokers/EnhancedIBConnectionManager.cs:21](../../../../src/Meridian.Infrastructure/Adapters/InteractiveBrokers/EnhancedIBConnectionManager.cs#L21).

IB connection manager that owns the socket/EReader loop and forwards raw callbacks into IBCallbackRouter. This file is buildable out-of-the-box: - When compiled WITHOUT the official IB API reference, it exposes a small stub implementation. - When compiled WITH the IB API (define the compilation constant IBAPI and reference IBApi), it provides a full EWrapper implementation with depth routing. Connection Resilience (IBAPI build): - Uses ExponentialBackoffRetry for connection retry with configurable delays (1s initial, 2min max) - Implements HeartbeatMonitor for connection health detection - Automatic reconnection on connection loss with jitter to prevent thundering herd - Unlimited retry attempts by default (configurable via maxRetries parameter) - See EnhancedIBConnectionManager.IBApi.cs and Infrastructure/Performance/ConnectionWarmUp.cs for implementation

```csharp

```

Concrete Interactive Brokers market data client. Buildable out-of-the-box: - Without IBAPI defined, delegates to IBSimulationClient (generates synthetic data for testing). - With IBAPI defined, uses EnhancedIBConnectionManager + IBCallbackRouter for real TWS/Gateway.
